ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: kind after kindnesses given and received

li.any: Kindness, NursedBack, SavedBy, ForgivenBy, TaughtWell, SavedSomeone, RaisedChild, BecameParent, Married

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: So much kindness given and taken has settled in {PAWN_objective}: {PAWN_pronoun} looks for the good in people now, and says so.

plain.li: Took the late watch so the new one could sleep. I didn't think about it until after.
I've started noticing who's had a bad day before they say anything.
Brought the cook a cup of something hot. The look on their face was worth the walk.

warm.li: People have been good to me here, more than I earned. It's easy to pass it on.

blunt.li: Helped where I could today. That's what you do.

cheerful.li: Left a carved bird on everyone's pillow. Some of them look more like potatoes. It's the thought.

gloomy.li: Life here is hard enough. I'd rather not add to it for anyone.

cold.li: I find I want the others to be well. I didn't use to. I'm not sure when it changed.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: sharp edges worn smooth by kindness

li.any: Kindness, ForgivenBy, NursedBack, SavedBy, Married, TaughtWell, BecameParent

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Too many people have been decent to {PAWN_objective} for {PAWN_objective} to keep snapping at them: the edge has gone out of how {PAWN_pronoun} speaks.

plain.li: I held my tongue today when I'd normally have had something to say. Then I said something kind instead.
Someone asked my advice instead of avoiding me. I gave it nicely, too.

warm.li: They kept being kind to me even when I was a misery. I think I owe them a gentler voice.

blunt.li: I still say what I think. I just don't make it hurt.

cheerful.li: I complimented someone's stew today and meant it. They checked my forehead for fever.

gloomy.li: Being sharp with people never made anything better. I suppose I've finally noticed.

cold.li: Unpleasantness costs more than it gains. I have revised my manner.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a wimp who held the line
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After standing in the fight and carrying the others through it, {PAWN_pronoun} no longer goes down at the first wound.

plain.li: Took a cut on the arm in the raid and kept going. I only noticed it afterwards.
I used to fold at the first scratch. Not anymore. I don't quite know what changed.

warm.li: Someone needed carrying, and I carried them. After that, a cut or two didn't seem worth stopping for.

blunt.li: Pain's just pain. I can work through it now.

cheerful.li: Stubbed my toe on the bed frame and kept walking. Growth.

gloomy.li: I suppose you toughen up or you don't last. I've lasted.

cold.li: My tolerance for injury has improved. A useful adaptation.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a brawler made in close fighting
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Fight after fight up close, blade in hand, has made {PAWN_objective} a fighter who wants to be in reach of the enemy, and who minds being handed a gun.

plain.li: They gave me a rifle for the wall today. I gave it back and went to stand by the gate.
When it comes to it, I want to see their faces. Shooting from a distance feels like cheating.

warm.li: If I'm close, I can put myself between them and the others. That's where I want to be.

blunt.li: Give me something with an edge and point me at them.

cheerful.li: Practised on the training dummy until it fell apart. Then I practised on its pieces.

gloomy.li: Up close is where I'm any use. I don't much like what that says about me.

cold.li: Melee is efficient and certain. Ranged weapons leave too much to chance.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: jealous after being passed over again and again
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Passed over at vote after vote, {PAWN_pronoun} keeps a close eye now on what everyone else has, starting with their rooms.

plain.li: Walked past the new speaker's room today. Bigger window than mine. Of course it is.
They vote for the same faces every time. I mind more than I let on.
I counted the furniture in everyone's rooms tonight. I'm not proud of it. I did it anyway.

warm.li: I want to be glad for them. Most days I manage. Today I didn't.

blunt.li: Others get the say and the good rooms. I get the leftovers.

cheerful.li: Lost another vote. I'm going to take it out on my bedroom, by asking for a nicer one.

gloomy.li: They never pick me. They never will. They'll keep the best for themselves, too.

cold.li: I've noted who has what. The distribution is not fair, and I will remember it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an ascetic made by hardship
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After going without for so long, comfort means little to {PAWN_objective}: a bare room suits {PAWN_objective} better than a fine one.

plain.li: Took the rug out of my room. I don't need it. I kept tripping over it anyway.
A bowl, a blanket, a roof. When you've been without, you learn how little the rest matters.

warm.li: Give the good bed to someone who'll enjoy it. I'm fine on the plain one, truly.

blunt.li: I don't need a nice room. Spend the wood on walls.

cheerful.li: My room has one chair and I'm very fond of it. We understand each other.

gloomy.li: Fine things only remind me how quickly they can be taken.

cold.li: Comfort is a dependency. I have reduced mine.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an ascetic drawn deeper into the faith
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The colony's rites have taken hold of {PAWN_objective}: what {PAWN_pronoun} owns matters less to {PAWN_objective} now than what {PAWN_pronoun} believes.

plain.li: After the ceremony I gave away my good boots. They felt like too much to be wearing.
I've started sitting with the faith in the mornings instead of eating. I don't miss breakfast.

warm.li: The rite showed me what I have here, and none of it is furniture.

blunt.li: Belief first. Things second. Things a distant second.

cheerful.li: I've decluttered my soul and my shelf on the same day. The shelf was harder.

gloomy.li: Everything I own will rot. What I believe might not.

cold.li: Possessions distract from the practice. I've let most of mine go.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: greed loosened by people worth more than things

li.any: Kindness, Married, RaisedChild, BecameParent, NursedBack, ForgivenBy, MovingRitual

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The people around {PAWN_objective} have come to matter more than what {PAWN_pronoun} owns: a plain room no longer feels like an insult.

plain.li: Gave my share of the silver to the kitchen fund. Didn't even haggle over it.
My room is no grander than anyone's. I keep forgetting to mind.

warm.li: I have people now. Next to that, a bigger room seems a silly thing to want.

blunt.li: Keep the fancy furniture. I'm fine.

cheerful.li: Someone admired my lamp and I gave it to them. I don't know who I am anymore and I love it.

gloomy.li: All the things I wanted wouldn't have kept anyone alive. People do that, sometimes.

cold.li: Accumulation has lost its appeal. My priorities have been recalculated.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: bloodlust in someone hardened by many kills
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed a taste for blood.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: So many kills, and a heart that has cooled with each one: {PAWN_nameDef} enjoys the fighting now, and the killing, and others have noticed.

plain.li: The raid ended and I was sorry it was over. I wrote that down to see how it looked. It looks bad.
I keep the count of them in my head. I'm not sure when I started.

warm.li: I tell myself I fight for the others. Today I fought because I wanted to.

blunt.li: I like the fighting. There, I said it.

cheerful.li: Another raid! Something in me lit up at the alarm, and I'm choosing not to think about it.

gloomy.li: Something in me has gone wrong out there. I can feel it smiling.

cold.li: Killing has become satisfying. I see no reason to pretend otherwise.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: used to stone overhead
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two seasons hardly ever under the open sky, and {PAWN_pronoun} has stopped missing it: walls and a roof feel like home now.

plain.li: Went outside for the harvest and the sky was too big. I was glad to get back in.
I like the sound of rain on the roof better than the rain itself.

warm.li: Inside is where everyone is. Why would I want to be anywhere else?

blunt.li: Don't need the sky. Got a ceiling.

cheerful.li: Someone said I'm turning into a mole. Moles are very contented animals.

gloomy.li: Nothing good ever came out of the open sky. Raiders, mostly.

cold.li: The outdoors offers nothing a roof doesn't improve on.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a recluse after being hurt by those close
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Hurt by the people closest to {PAWN_objective}, {PAWN_pronoun} would rather live among few: a small colony suits {PAWN_objective}, a crowded one wears on {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: Ate supper on the step outside. Fewer voices. Fewer people to explain myself to.
Another newcomer today. I learned their name and then went for a long walk.

warm.li: I care about the few I have left. I don't think I have room for more.

blunt.li: Too many people here. Not enough quiet.

cheerful.li: Found a spot behind the storehouse nobody else knows about. It's mine now. Don't tell anyone.

gloomy.li: Every new face is someone else who can let me down.

cold.li: Fewer people, fewer complications. I prefer the arithmetic.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: drawn to the unknown after touching it
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Each brush with the dark has drawn {PAWN_objective} closer instead of driving {PAWN_objective} off: {PAWN_pronoun} wants to know what's on the other side.

plain.li: I went and stood by the containment cell again tonight. Just to listen.
The others look away from it. I can't. I don't want to.

warm.li: I'd never let it hurt anyone here. But I want to understand it. Someone should.

blunt.li: It's out there. I want to know what it is.

cheerful.li: Sketched the strange thing in the cell today. It sat very still for me. Good subject.

gloomy.li: It calls, and I'm the only one who answers. That can't end well.

cold.li: The unknown is the only thing here that still interests me.
